description: Each current director (chair first) of one ASX company with their record at other ASX companies: board seats, completed tenures, median annualised share-price return vs CS200EW over completed tenures of a year or more (scoredTenures says how many; under 2 is an anecdote), outcomes (takeovers with premium, administrations, delistings), capital raised and dilution - and up to 10 of those tenures with docKeys. Suited to 'who runs this company and have they done it before' and board-quality questions. Caveats: survivorship, price-only returns. Free.
name: board_track_record
title: Board track record
